title: Coefficient comparison under sectionwise quasi-isomorphisms
statement: Let e:F[0] → G be a map from a single O_X-module sheaf into a cochain complex, and let V be a finite open family. If sections of e over every increasing-tuple intersection are quasi-isomorphisms, then the explicit coefficient map beta [lem-weil-pbc-ordered-cech-coefficient-map] into the ordered Cech total [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex] is a quasi-isomorphism. Neither the cover condition nor flasqueness nor a boundedness hypothesis is needed. The category of module sheaves is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: Apply sectionwise total comparison to e to obtain a quasi-isomorphism Tot(F[0]) → Tot(G).
The explicit coefficient map for the identity of F[0] is an isomorphism. Its composite with Tot(e) equals beta(e) by coefficient-map naturality. Hence beta(e) is a quasi-isomorphism.
